metadata.description: Piping engineering skills for Claude from Piping Toolset.

plugins.name: piping-toolset
plugins.description: ASME B31.1 / B31.3 piping engineering skills from Piping Toolset (pipingtoolset.com): load-case-builder (CAESAR II and AutoPIPE load case sets), pressure-design (wall thickness, allowable pressure, branch reinforcement, bends, miters, leak test) and stress-screening (SUS/OCC/EXP hand checks, f factor, SIF source, exemption, spans). No code table values are embedded.
